description: Multi-session support for moor-mcp-host: SessionManager, player creation, session lifecycle tools, session-aware dispatch, and narrative event delivery

userStories.title: Add LoginMode::Create to MoorClient
userStories.description: As a developer, I need MoorClient to support both 'connect' and 'create' login verbs so that new player accounts can be created through the RPC layer.
acceptanceCriteria: Add LoginMode enum with Connect and Create variants to moor_client.rs
Add LoginInfo struct with fields: player (Obj), connect_type (string), player_flags (u32)
Add login_with_mode(mode, username, password) -> Result<LoginInfo> method to MoorClient
LoginMode::Create sends ['create', username, password] as connect_args to mk_login_command_msg
LoginMode::Connect sends ['connect', username, password] (current behavior)
Existing login() method delegates to login_with_mode(Connect, ...) for backward compat
Stored credentials include the login mode for reconnection in reconnect()
cargo check passes
userStories.notes: This is a targeted change to moor_client.rs only. The daemon already handles 'create' in perform_login() via args[0] == 'create'.

userStories.title: Create PlayerSession and SessionManager structs
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a SessionManager that can hold N dynamic player sessions so that multiple agents can connect through one server.
acceptanceCriteria: Create new file session_manager.rs with PlayerSession and SessionManager structs
PlayerSession contains: id (Uuid), username (String), player (Obj), created_at (SystemTime), last_used_at (Mutex<SystemTime>), client (Mutex<MoorClient>), status enum (Active/Errored/Expired)

SessionManager contains: config (MoorClientConfig), programmer_service (Option<Mutex<MoorClient>>), wizard_service (Option<Mutex<MoorClient>>), sessions (RwLock<HashMap<Uuid, Arc<PlayerSession>>>), max_sessions (usize), session_idle_ttl (Duration)
SessionManager::new() accepts config, optional programmer/wizard credentials, max_sessions, session_idle_ttl
Add create_session(login_mode, username, password) -> Result<(Uuid, LoginInfo)> that creates a MoorClient, connects, logs in, and stores the session
Add get_session(id) -> Option<Arc<PlayerSession>> that validates session exists and is active
Add close_session(id) -> Result<()> that disconnects and removes the session
Add list_sessions() -> Vec of session info (id, username, player, status, last_used_at)
Add cleanup_expired_sessions() that removes sessions idle longer than session_idle_ttl
Enforce max_sessions limit in create_session, returning error when exceeded
Add mod session_manager to main.rs
cargo check passes
userStories.notes: This is a new file. Does not replace ConnectionManager yet — that happens in the integration story.

userStories.title: Add creation policy configuration
userStories.description: As a server operator, I want to control whether agents can self-register via CLI args so that I can enforce security policies.
acceptanceCriteria: Add CreationPolicy enum: Open, Token, AdminOnly, Disabled to session_manager.rs
Add --creation-policy CLI arg with values: open, token, admin-only, disabled (default: disabled)
Add --creation-token CLI arg (string, required when policy is 'token')
Add --max-sessions CLI arg (usize, default: 100)
Add --session-idle-ttl CLI arg (string like '30m', default: '30m')
All new args also configurable via YAML config file
Add check_creation_policy(policy, provided_token) -> Result<()> method to SessionManager that returns error when creation is not allowed
cargo check passes
userStories.notes: Policy enforcement is just validation logic here. It gets wired into the MCP tools in a later story.

userStories.title: Integrate SessionManager into McpServer replacing ConnectionManager
userStories.description: As a developer, I need McpServer to use SessionManager instead of ConnectionManager so that session-aware dispatch is possible.
acceptanceCriteria: McpServer stores SessionManager instead of ConnectionManager
McpServer tracks current_session_id: Option<Uuid>
Update main.rs to construct SessionManager with programmer/wizard credentials from existing CLI args plus new session config args

Add get_client_for_tool(wizard, session_id_param) method to McpServer that resolves: wizard-only -> wizard_service, explicit session_id -> that session, current_session_id -> that session, fallback -> programmer_service
Update handle_tools_call to use get_client_for_tool instead of connections.get(wizard)
Update handle_reconnect to reconnect service clients and all active sessions
Update disconnect_all on shutdown to close all sessions
Existing tools continue to work via programmer_service fallback when no sessions exist
cargo check passes
userStories.notes: This is the main integration story. After this, the old connection.rs is no longer used. Dynamic tool and resource fetching should use programmer_service or wizard_service.

userStories.title: Add session lifecycle MCP tools
userStories.description: As an AI agent, I want MCP tools to create, login, select, list, and close sessions so I can manage my identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Add moo_session_create tool: args {username, password, enrollment_token?, set_current?: true} -> {session_id, player, connect_type}
moo_session_create enforces creation policy (calls check_creation_policy)
Add moo_session_login tool: args {username, password, set_current?: true} -> {session_id, player, connect_type}
Add moo_session_use tool: args {session_id} -> sets current_session_id
Add moo_session_close tool: args {session_id?} -> disconnects and removes session (defaults to current)
Add moo_sessions_list tool: no args -> returns list of {session_id, username, player, status, last_used_at}
All five tools registered in get_tools() and dispatched in execute_tool()
All tools return clear error messages for: max sessions reached, invalid session_id, creation disabled, bad token
cargo check passes
userStories.notes: These are meta-tools handled in mcp_server.rs similar to moo_reconnect and moo_refresh_dynamic_tools. They don't go through the normal client dispatch.

userStories.title: Add optional session_id parameter to all non-wizard tools
userStories.description: As an agent with a session, I want to pass session_id to any tool so it executes as my player.
acceptanceCriteria: Add session_id (optional string) to the input_schema of every tool created via with_wizard_param() in get_tools()
Create a helper function add_session_id_param(tool: Tool) -> Tool that adds the session_id property to a tool's input_schema
Apply add_session_id_param to all non-wizard-only tools in get_tools()
The session_id parameter is extracted in handle_tools_call and passed to get_client_for_tool for dispatch
Wizard-only tools (created via wizard_required()) do NOT get session_id param
Tool descriptions mention session_id is optional and defaults to current session
cargo check passes
userStories.notes: This is a mechanical change to tool schema generation and the dispatch layer. Individual tool execute functions don't change — they still receive &mut MoorClient.

userStories.title: Add narrative event subscription to PlayerSession
userStories.description: As a developer, I need each PlayerSession to subscribe to narrative events from the daemon so agents can perceive the world.
acceptanceCriteria: PlayerSession starts a background tokio task that subscribes to the player's narrative event stream
Events are parsed using existing extract_narrative_text / narrative_event_from_ref utilities
Events are stored in a bounded buffer (VecDeque with max 1000 entries, oldest dropped when full)
Each buffered event contains: event_type (notify/traceback/present/unpresent), content (String), timestamp (SystemTime)
Buffer is wrapped in Mutex for safe concurrent access
Event subscription task starts after successful login in create_session
Event subscription task stops when session is closed (via kill switch AtomicBool)
Add drain_events() method to PlayerSession that returns and clears buffered events
cargo check passes
userStories.notes: Modeled after the existing ping responder pattern in MoorClient — background task with kill switch. Uses the ZMQ events subscriber.

userStories.title: Add moo_session_events polling tool
userStories.description: As an AI agent, I want to poll for narrative events so I can perceive what's happening in the MOO world.
acceptanceCriteria: Add moo_session_events tool: args {session_id?, timeout_ms?: 5000}
Returns list of {type, content, timestamp} events from the session's buffer
timeout_ms: 0 returns immediately with whatever is buffered
timeout_ms > 0 waits up to that duration for at least one event if buffer is empty
After returning, the returned events are cleared from the buffer
Returns error if session_id is invalid or no current session is set
Tool registered in get_tools() and dispatched in mcp_server.rs
cargo check passes
userStories.notes: This is a meta-tool like the session lifecycle tools — it needs direct access to the SessionManager, not just a MoorClient.

userStories.title: Session reconnect support
userStories.description: As a server operator, I want all sessions to recover from daemon restarts so agents don't lose their state.
acceptanceCriteria: SessionManager::reconnect_all() reconnects programmer_service, wizard_service, AND all active player sessions
Per-session reconnect uses stored credentials and original LoginMode
Sessions that fail reconnection have status set to Errored (not removed)
moo_sessions_list shows session status: Active, Errored, Expired
moo_reconnect tool result message lists: service clients reconnected, sessions succeeded, sessions failed
Errored sessions can be retried via a subsequent moo_reconnect call
cargo check passes
userStories.notes: Extends the existing moo_reconnect meta-tool. Uses MoorClient::reconnect_with_backoff() which already exists.

userStories.title: Remove old ConnectionManager and clean up
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove dead code and ensure the refactored crate is clean.
acceptanceCriteria: connection.rs is deleted (ConnectionManager fully replaced by SessionManager)
All references to ConnectionManager removed from main.rs, mcp_server.rs, and mod declarations
No dead code warnings related to the old connection module
cargo check passes
cargo test passes (if any tests exist in the crate)
cargo clippy passes with no new warnings
userStories.notes: Final cleanup story. Should be trivial if US-004 was done correctly.
